subject: Shield stab
text: Holding R while not locked-on and pressing B executes a shield stab repeatedly faster than a normal slash.

evidence.quote: You can hold R while NOT locked-on and press B to stab. You can do this repeatedly faster than a normal slash, and is recommended for defeating bosses in the shortest time possible.

subject: Shield stab
text: A shield stab maintains the attack power of the previous attack performed, such as a jump slash with a Deku Stick.

evidence.quote: It basically has the attack power of the last attack you did. For example, if you used a jump slash for a Deku Stick, then immediately get rid of the stick and do a shield stab, each stab will have the same power of that jump slashed Deku Stick.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: A Blue Rupee is worth 5 Rupees, and 40 Rupees are needed to buy the shield.

evidence.quote: At your right there's a Blue Rupee (worth 5). Collect it. You'll need 40 Rupees to buy that shield.

subject: treasure chest
text: A treasure chest inside the boulder maze contains the Kokiri Sword.

evidence.quote: You'll find a treasure chest with the KOKIRI SWORD inside.

subject: Deku Shield
text: The Deku Shield bought from the shop is made of wood and can be burnt completely off by fire or fire-based enemies.

evidence.quote: Now, talk to the shop owner and buy that DEKU SHIELD. Now, this is an okay shield made with very strong wood, but remember, it is still wooden, and can be burnt completely off, rendering you defenseless, so remember that and be careful among fire or fire-based enemies.

subject: Deku Baba
text: Defeating Deku Babas causes them to drop Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote: Go through the path and defeat the Deku Babas. (They shouldn't harm you.) They'll drop some DEKU STICKS.

subject: treasure chest
text: Opening the treasure chest reached by climbing the ladder or wall vines awards the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Either way, head over to where the treasure chest is. Open it to get the DUNGEON MAP!

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Deflecting a Deku Nut back at a Deku Scrub using a shield causes it to run away.

evidence.quote: Shielding against the Deku Nuts fires them back, so deflect the Deku Nut back at the Scrub and it'll run away.

subject: treasure chest
text: Opening the treasure chest across the falling platform yields the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Open the chest here to get the FAIRY SLINGSHOT.

subject: treasure chest
text: A treasure chest at the top of the ladder to the left of the slingshot chest contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: To the left of the chest is a ladder. Climb it to reach another chest. Open it for a mere RECOVERY HEART.

subject: Skullwalltula
text: Skullwalltulas on the vines can be defeated with 1 Deku Seed from the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Aim up at the spiders (Skullwalltulas) and use the Fairy Slingshot to kill them. It should take one Deku Seed to kill them.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Big Skulltulas are defeated by striking their stomach.

evidence.quote: Head along this path, defeating any Big Skulltulas you come across (striking the stomach kills them), and come into the door here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Defeating the Gold Skulltula in the side alcove yields a token to collect.

evidence.quote: In this alcove is a Gold Skulltula... Kill the Skulltula and collect the token it leaves behind.

subject: treasure chest
text: The treasure chest in the Gold Skulltula alcove contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: The chest here contains another RECOVERY HEART.

subject: treasure chest
text: Opening the treasure chest on the opposite side of the raised platform room awards the Compass.

evidence.quote: Head over to the other side with a treasure chest (you may have to hit the switch again to raise the platforms again). Open the chest to get the COMPASS.

subject: Deku Stick
text: A Deku Stick burns out after a few seconds, but pressing A puts it away and extinguishes the flame to save the stick.

evidence.quote: You have to hurry; the Deku Stick will burn out after a few seconds, wasting a stick. Once you are done, press A to put the stick away and burn out the flames, saving the Deku Stick you used.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula found on the vines in the watery room leaves a token when killed.

evidence.quote: There's another Gold Skulltula here. Kill the Skulltula and climb up the vines to get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Killing the Gold Skulltula on the northern grate with a Deku Seed allows Link to collect its token.

evidence.quote: Look over to the northern grate to see another Gold Skulltula. Kill it with a Deku Seed, then jump over to the token.

subject: treasure chest
text: A treasure chest near the unlit torch on the switch platform contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: There's a chest near the unlit torch here which contains another RECOVERY HEART.

subject: underwater switch
text: Diving down to press the switch on the left temporarily lowers the water level to allow riding the moving platform under the spiked log.

evidence.quote: Jump into the water and dive down (holding A) to the switch to the left. When you hit the switch, the water will be lowered temporarily. Use this time to get back onto surface and hop onto the moving platform.

subject: Gohma Larva
text: Gohma Larvae drop down from the ceiling and are killed by hitting them in the eye.

evidence.quote: Gohma Larvae will drop down. Hitting them in the eye will kill them.
